analytic_rules: For exactly equal scalar inputs and ν=0, every deterministic fixed scalar f yields equality.
For ordered inputs, strict increasing/decreasing maps preserve/reverse strict order; weak maps add zero.
Arbitrary fixed f or unrestricted-sign heterogeneous mixtures can preserve, reverse or erase distinct scalar order.
Unrestricted ν permits cancellation or either sign even for equal scalar inputs.
Known input scale cannot be inferred from invariant order; no magnitude or temporal claim follows.

numerics.mode: Decimal arithmetic over frozen decimal tokens
numerics.exact_equal: {0} source order; exact stored equality only
numerics.small_nonzero: source sign set {-1,0,+1}, flagged numerical ambiguity, never rounded to established zero
numerics.larger_nonzero: stored sign, marked a model-artifact comparison

validity: Analytic invariance over the declared mathematical family, not physiological validation. Finite examples never certify an unbounded family.
nontractable: Any extension not covered by the frozen analytic rules must be UNINTERPRETABLE until separately preregistered; do not fall back to a favorable grid.
robust_atomic_claim: For a specified contrast and family, the output sign set is a singleton; or an explicitly set-valued claim is proven for all family members. Do not relabel union breadth as one fixed neural outcome.
